What this experience covers

A chauffeured bachelorette night typically runs hotel or Airbnb pickup → dinner or first confirmed venue → additional confirmed Old Town stops on a compact route → optional photo stop if timing allows → scheduled return to one address. Bookings are hourly charters so multi-stop nights sit inside one bought window — the group does not scatter across rideshares. Share date, pickup location, guest count, approximate hours, and venue stops (even if approximate) so curb access and the communication plan can be confirmed in writing. Party Sprinters and party buses are priced by the hour on published minimums — see the bachelorette service page and checkout; this page does not invent mystery packages or dollar figures.

Pick the right vehicle

Qualitative chooser — lock vehicle fit and live rates on the bachelorette service and fleet pages:

  • Party Sprinters / Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter — lounge feel for mid-size groups (Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter, Limo Sprinter).
  • Party Bus — larger headcounts (Party Bus, party bus rental).
  • Pink Hummer Limo — pink arrival photo moment (Pink Hummer).
  • Executive Sprinter — quieter dinner-first or daytime plans before or instead of a party cabin (Executive Sprinter).

Example itinerary

  1. Pickup at the confirmed hotel or Airbnb. Name a trip lead (usually the maid of honor) who holds the phone and knows the approved curb.
  2. Dinner or first confirmed venue. Drop at the venue’s current access point — access changes with closures and traffic controls.
  3. Additional confirmed Old Town stops on a compact route. Keep the list practical; last-minute extra addresses may not fit remaining hours.
  4. Photo stop if timing allows. Add it when you book.
  5. Scheduled return to one address. One return plan keeps the group together at the end of the night.

House rules

Alcohol: Follow published house rules and Arizona vehicle-for-hire open-container rules. Passengers 21+ may bring their own alcohol only when allowed for the assigned vehicle and stated in booking terms; Scottsdale Sprinters does not sell alcohol. If anyone under 21 rides, alcohol does not come on board that trip. Read /ride-rules and ask reservations before you plan an onboard toast.

Decorations and props: Need a yes from reservations for that vehicle, confirmed in the trip details and written confirmation. Do not assume party-store decorations are cleared.

Cleaning expectations: Follow the booking terms and ride rules for spills and damage. Ask reservations if anything is unclear before the night.

“Packages” on this site are hourly builds from published vehicle rates and minimums — not mystery bundles. Verify live wording on the bachelorette service page.

Frequently asked questions

What’s the best transportation for a bachelorette party in Scottsdale?

Most groups keep everyone together in a chauffeured party Sprinter or party bus booked by the hour, sized to the guest count, with a planned Old Town route and one return address. Compare party Sprinters, the Party Bus, and the Pink Hummer Limo on Scottsdale Sprinters’ bachelorette service page, then confirm the total in live checkout.

Can we decorate the Sprinter or bring our own alcohol?

Decorations need approval in the trip details and written confirmation (some surfaces may be restricted). Alcohol may be allowed only for passengers 21+ when lawful, approved for that vehicle, and stated in the booking terms. Scottsdale Sprinters does not sell alcohol. Ask reservations before you buy décor or plan an onboard toast. Full rules: /ride-rules.

How do we book bachelorette transportation for Old Town Scottsdale?

Share date, pickup location, passenger count, approximate hours, and venue stops (even if approximate). Call or text (623) 986-6339, email reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com, or use /contact. Published hourly rates and minimums appear on the fleet and service pages and at checkout — confirm the total in live checkout; this page does not invent rates.

Can the chauffeur wait while we’re inside?

Waiting and staging depend on the requested service window and each venue’s current access rules. The written confirmation identifies the communication plan and approved pickup points.

Can we do dinner and Old Town on one booking?

Yes when every address and the return window are on the reservation. Hourly charters put multi-stop nights inside one bought window. Share the full list up front so the team can confirm whether the hours cover the route.
